title: WordPress to Next.js Migration for an Organic Skincare Brand
excerpt: How we migrated SÁRA Cosmetics from a slow WordPress + WooCommerce setup to a headless Next.js storefront, tripling page speed and doubling organic traffic.
challenge: SÁRA Cosmetics, a Berlin-based organic skincare brand, had outgrown their WordPress + WooCommerce website. Page load times exceeded 8 seconds on mobile, the checkout flow was clunky, and their SEO rankings were declining despite quality content. With a growing product catalog and increasing traffic, the legacy stack was becoming a bottleneck for growth.
solution: We migrated the entire storefront to a headless architecture using Next.js with static generation for product pages and Shopify Storefront API for commerce functionality. The migration preserved all existing URL structures and SEO equity while delivering sub-second load times. We implemented structured data markup for all products, optimized images with next/image, and built a custom CMS integration so the team could manage blog content and product descriptions independently.
results: PageSpeed score jumped from 28 to 96 on mobile
Organic traffic increased 110% within three months of launch
Average page load time reduced from 8.2s to 0.9s
Checkout completion rate improved by 35% with streamlined flow
Zero downtime during migration with parallel deployment strategy

testimonial.quote: webvise handled the entire migration seamlessly - our customers didn't notice any disruption, but the speed difference is night and day. Our site finally matches the quality of our products.
testimonial.author: L. Neumann
